tldr: Retrials without verbalized feedback—a simple mechanism that retries problem-solving attempts upon identifying incorrect answers—often outperform more sophisticated reasoning frameworks like Tree of Thoughts and Reflexion at significantly lower cost.
contributions: Introduction of 'retrials without feedback' as a simple yet effective mechanism for enhancing LLM reasoning
Demonstration that simpler methods (IO, CoT) with retrials outperform complex reasoning frameworks under constrained budgets
Challenge to the assumption that more intricate reasoning strategies inherently lead to better performance
Analysis of temperature's effect on retrial-based cost efficiency
methods: The authors evaluated four prompting strategies—Standard IO, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT), and Reflexion—under a retrial mechanism on three benchmarks: Game of 24 (100-test-puzzle math reasoning), HumanEval (161 Python programs), and HotpotQA (100 multi-hop QA samples). Each method iteratively retried unsolved samples until a predefined budget was exhausted or all were solved. Experiments used GPT-4o-mini and LLaMA-3.3-70B as base models, with cost measured in USD and success rate/accuracy as quality metrics. A temperature analysis was also conducted for Game of 24 across CoT and ToT methods.
results: CoT prompting consistently outperformed complex methods, achieving 94% success rate on Game of 24 with GPT-4o-mini—a result that ToT and Reflexion would require approximately $600 to achieve on GPT-4. For HumanEval and HotpotQA, CoT and IO reached performance plateaus earlier than Game of 24. With GPT-4o-mini, higher temperature values improved success rates, with CoT at temperature 1.0 achieving 100% accuracy at half the allocated budget on Game of 24. On LLaMA-3.3-70B, CoT substantially outperformed IO on Game of 24 and HotpotQA, though ToT slightly outperformed CoT on HotpotQA. Per-sample analysis showed ToT and Reflexion achieved stronger performance with fewer retrials on Game of 24 and HotpotQA, but CoT and IO ultimately surpassed them as retrials increased.
limitations: The method cannot be applied to tasks where answers cannot be directly verified, such as HotpotQA where correct answers are hidden during solving
For HumanEval, Reflexion and ToT were observed to surpass simpler methods if given more budget, indicating limitations under unconstrained settings
Temperature analysis for LLaMA-3.3-70B had not yet plateaued, limiting conclusiveness due to the model being approximately three times more expensive than GPT-4o-mini
